- Although you contribute £50/week towards Alex's upkeep (which is sufficient)
- Alex has started an apprenticeship in Northern Ireland
- For children 16 or over, they must be in "approved education or training" to continue qualifying
- The rules specify that apprenticeships in England disqualify a child, but Northern Ireland apprenticeships are not covered as approved education/training under the rules provided

You can proceed to claim Child Benefit for Blake. If you have questions about Alex's specific situation regarding the Northern Ireland apprenticeship, you may want to contact the Child Benefit Office directly for clarification.
